text.tr: Yeni bir klasörü hangi komut açar?
text.en: Which command creates a new folder?

explanation.en: make directory.

text.en: What does `mkdir a b c` do?

explanation.en: Each argument is a separate folder.

text.en: What happens with `mkdir site/css` when `site` does not exist?

tr: Hata verir: No such file or directory
en: An error: No such file or directory

explanation.tr: Üst klasör yoksa mkdir onu kendiliğinden açmaz.
explanation.en: mkdir does not create a missing parent by itself.

text.tr: İç içe klasörleri tek komutla açan seçenek hangisi?
text.en: Which option creates nested folders in one command?

explanation.en: p: parents.

text.tr: Var olan bir klasörü `mkdir` ile yeniden açmaya çalışırsan?
text.en: What happens if you try to create an existing folder with `mkdir`?

explanation.en: mkdir -p just quietly does nothing.

text.en: What does `touch notes.txt` do if the file does not exist?

explanation.tr: Var olan dosyaya dokunmaz, içeriğini silmez.
explanation.en: It does not change the content of an existing file.

text.en: What does `touch` do if the file already exists?

tr: İçeriğe dokunmaz, yalnızca değişiklik zamanını günceller
en: Leaves the content alone, only updates the modification time

explanation.en: That is where the name comes from.

text.en: What does `echo "Buy milk" > list.txt` do?

en: Writes the text to the screen and the file

explanation.en: > sends the output to a file instead of the screen.

text.tr: `>` ile içinde yazı olan bir dosyaya yazarsan eski içerik ne olur?
text.en: If you write with `>` to a file that has text, what happens to the old content?

en: The new text is added to the end
It is added to the start

explanation.en: It erases without asking; careful!

text.tr: Dosyanın sonuna satır eklemek için ne kullanılır?
text.en: What do you use to add a line to the end of a file?

explanation.en: Two arrows: append.

text.en: What does `cat list.txt` do?

en: Prints the contents of the file

explanation.en: The name comes from concatenate.

text.en: What does `cat a.txt b.txt` do?

en: Prints the two files one after the other

explanation.en: concatenate: join one after another.

text.en: What does `cat -n` add?

explanation.en: n: number.

text.tr: Boş bir dosyaya `cat` uygularsan ne görürsün?
text.en: What do you see if you `cat` an empty file?

explanation.en: There is nothing to print.

text.en: Which folders can `rmdir` delete?

explanation.tr: İçi doluysa Directory not empty der.
explanation.en: If it is not empty it says Directory not empty.

text.en: What is the output of `rmdir full` (it has a file inside)?

tr: rmdir: failed to remove 'full': Directory not empty
en: rmdir: failed to remove 'full': Directory not empty

explanation.tr: rmdir içindekileri silmez; güvenli tarafta kalır.
explanation.en: rmdir does not delete the contents; it plays safe.

text.en: How do you create a hidden file?

en: By starting its name with a dot: touch .secret

explanation.tr: Linux'ta gizlilik yalnızca adın ilk harfi.
explanation.en: On Linux, hidden is just the first character of the name.

text.tr: Linux için dosya uzantısı (`.txt`) hakkında hangisi doğru?
text.en: Which is true about a file extension (`.txt`) on Linux?

tr: Adın bir parçasıdır; sistem içeriğe bakarak karar verir
en: It is part of the name; the system decides from the content

explanation.tr: notes, notes.txt ve notes.md aynı türde metin olabilir.
explanation.en: notes, notes.txt and notes.md can all be the same kind of text.

text.en: Can `Report.txt` and `report.txt` be in the same folder?

en: Yes, on Linux they are two files
No, it is the same name

explanation.tr: Windows bunu bir sayar; Linux iki.
explanation.en: Windows sees one name; Linux sees two.

text.en: What does `touch my file.txt` (without quotes) do?

tr: my ve file.txt adında iki dosya oluşturur
my file.txt adında bir dosya oluşturur
en: Creates two files, my and file.txt
Creates one file called my file.txt

explanation.en: The space separates the arguments.

text.tr: Dosya adlarında boşluk yerine en sık ne kullanılır?
text.en: What is most often used instead of spaces in file names?

explanation.en: my-notes.txt, my_notes.txt.

text.tr: Bu bölümde hangi komut bir dosyanın içini değiştirmeden oluşturur?
text.en: In this section, which command creates a file without changing its content?

explanation.en: echo > rewrites the content.

text.tr: `echo "a" > notes/x.txt` notes klasörü yokken ne olur?
text.en: What happens with `echo "a" > notes/x.txt` when the notes folder does not exist?

tr: Hata: No such file or directory
en: An error: No such file or directory
x.txt is created in the home folder

explanation.en: > does not create folders; mkdir first.

text.en: What do you see when `mkdir` succeeds in the terminal?

explanation.tr: Sessizlik başarı demek; emin olmak için ls.
explanation.en: Silence means success; check with ls.
